title: Rename business to Skynet Services across website UI

requirements.summary: Replace all user-facing occurrences of the old business name with "Skynet Services" and update logo alt text accordingly.
acceptanceCriteria: The header brand name text displays "Skynet Services" instead of "SecureConnect".
The footer brand name text displays "Skynet Services" instead of "SecureConnect".
The About section heading reads "Why Choose Skynet Services" (replacing the old name).
The footer copyright line uses "Skynet Services".
The header/footer logo image alt text references "Skynet Services" (not "SecureConnect").
No other user-facing text is unintentionally changed.

file_operations.description: Update the header brand text from "SecureConnect" to "Skynet Services" and adjust the header logo image alt text to reference "Skynet Services".

Update the footer brand text from "SecureConnect" to "Skynet Services", update the footer logo image alt text to reference "Skynet Services", and update the footer copyright line to use "Skynet Services".
Update the About section heading so it reads "Why Choose Skynet Services" (replacing the old business name in the heading).

requirements.summary: Update the HTML document title to include "Skynet Services".
acceptanceCriteria: The browser tab title includes "Skynet Services".

file_operations.description: Replace the existing <title> text with a title that includes the business name "Skynet Services".
